findings.current: At this rate, I was going to be the only one getting attacked—
findings.defect: The translation preserves that Taekyung alone will be targeted but omits 줄창, which says the attacks will continue relentlessly.
findings.rationale: The source conveys both exclusive targeting and continuous attacks; the accepted baseline also preserved the latter detail.
findings.replacement: At this rate, they were going to keep attacking me and me alone—

findings.current: The green wetlands were soaked with the corpses and blood of the ones already dead.
findings.defect: 잠겨 있었고 describes the wetlands as awash or inundated with bodies and blood. “Soaked with the corpses” is physically inaccurate and weakens the extent of the aftermath.
findings.rationale: The source presents the corpses and blood as engulfing the wetlands, not as something the wetlands have absorbed.
findings.replacement: The green wetlands were awash with the bodies and blood of the Lizardmen that had already fallen.

findings.current: So you just slipped out alone while it was crawling with monsters?
findings.defect: 혼자 빠져요 means Choi opted out of the fight, not that he slipped away from the location. He remained nearby and watched.
findings.rationale: The complaint concerns Choi deliberately withholding his participation, consistent with his continuing physical presence in the scene.
findings.replacement: So you just sat out the fight while the place was crawling with monsters?

findings.current: But rude as the Sangdong Guild Master is, he isn’t the type to make up a story.
findings.defect: “Rude” softens 싸가지 없는 새끼, which is a direct, profane insult equivalent to calling him an ill-mannered bastard.
findings.rationale: The Guild Master repeatedly uses coarse insults in this exchange; the source does not reduce this second insult to ordinary criticism.
findings.replacement: The Sangdong Guild Master may be an ill-mannered bastard, but he isn’t the type to make up a story.

findings.current: Shut your mouth, leave quietly, and I won’t block your path.
findings.defect: “Leave” softens 꺼지면, an openly hostile command to get out, during the Guild Master’s profane dismissal of Kim Sangshik.
findings.rationale: The source combines 입 닥치고 with 꺼지면 to express tightly controlled but unmistakably abusive fury.
findings.replacement: Shut your mouth and get the hell out quietly, and I won’t stand in your way.

findings.current: Along with that, the hottest topic in the Guild became the recent whereabouts of the bottom-tier Hunter who had left not long before.
findings.defect: 근황 means Taekyung’s latest news or current circumstances, not specifically his whereabouts. The latter remains unknown and becomes the final question of the chapter.
findings.rationale: The ensuing gossip concerns his reawakening and career situation, then ends by asking where he currently is; rendering 근황 as “whereabouts” blurs that progression.
findings.replacement: Along with that, the hottest topic in the Guild became the latest news about the bottom-tier Hunter who had left not long before.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with six minor defects involving omitted continuity detail, physical description, action, register, and one mistranslated topic.
